rating.summary: ICRA notes that HCLTech continues to strengthen its positioning in the emerging AI ecosystem through investments in platforms, partnerships, workforce upskilling and infrastructure. ICRA expects HCLTech to continue evaluating capability-led inorganic opportunities, and any sizeable acquisition and its impact on liquidity, leverage and cash flows will remain a key monitorable.
